jobs.description: Legal-dong code changes from code.go.kr (root ADR-0143, ADR-0144), the collection half: first ask the site's own change-period filter which codes were created or abolished inside the window the last full run anchored (about 70 KB, root ADR-0322 §2); when it lists the same rows and no full reconcile is owed (code-go-kr-legal-dong.contract.json full_table.changed_since_probe), record the confirmation and stop. Otherwise land the full table (codes, parents, created and abolished dates) in Bronze (requests at least 15 seconds apart; the change-notice board is not a source), refuse a response whose shape changed or a table that shrank past the contract's bounds, record when the table was last confirmed, and, only when the table's rows changed, write a pending-load handoff. No Spark: lineage_stewardship loads and pairs the handoff under its spark slots before its own steps.
